text:
frank: Quick announce: released redwood-eval-sets v0.2.0 and scheduling a Community Maintainer Summit next week. Eval sets repo now includes 12 curated prompt suites, baseline metrics, and an automated eval CI. Summit will cover maintainer policies (contrib guidelines, deprecation timelines, security expectations). Details and links below.

repo-bot: Release published: redwood-inference/redwood-eval-sets v0.2.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-eval-sets/releases/tag/v0.2.0
Changelog: add 12 eval suites, baseline model results, eval CI workflow, CONTRIBUTING + EVAL_README.

jen: Nice! quick run example for running a local eval: 
```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-eval-sets.git
cd redwood-eval-sets
# run single suite against a local model endpoint
EVAL_SUITE=conversational-reasoning REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx npm run eval:once
```

lydia: License? MIT ok for eval sets? want permissive for community reuse.

frank: We'll use CC-BY-4.0 for the eval data and MIT for tooling. noted in LICENSE.

arya: Summit logistics: Tue 10am PT, 90min. agenda draft: 1) contributions & maintainer expectations, 2) deprecation policy proposal, 3) security & CI best practices, 4) open floor for maintainer use-cases. RSVP link below.

devrel-bot: Summit RSVP + agenda feedback: https://forms.gle/example-maintainer-summit (tick topics you want discussed)

oliver: Deprecation policy idea: set a 6-month notice for deprecated templates/plugins, provide auto-migration notes, and add a "deprecation flag" in repo metadata.

jen: Security note for evals: avoid embedding PII in test prompts. We added a redaction checklist in EVAL_README. Maintainers should run the checklist before adding new suites.

frank: Good point. EVAL_README includes sanitization steps and an automated PII-scan GH Action.

arya: Also proposing a small change to CONTRIBUTING: require a minimal benchmark (pass rate or BLEU-like metric) for new evals and a short expected-maintenance plan. Want to minimize churn.

lydia: Sounds reasonable. Can we add an optional "maintainer mentor" label for first-time contributors so incubator folks can get help?

frank: Love that. We'll add a MAINTAINER_MENTOR label and a short onboarding doc.

repo-bot: Patch notes highlight:
- feat: 12 curated eval suites + baseline results
- ci: eval CI workflow + PII scan action
- docs: EVAL_README, CONTRIBUTING updates, deprecation proposal

oliver: Two-line blurb for community newsletter?

frank: "redwood-eval-sets v0.2  12 curated eval suites + automated eval CI. Join the Community Maintainer Summit Tue 10am PT to discuss contribution policies and deprecation timelines."

jen: I'll demo running the conversational-reasoning suite during the summit. need a co-presenter for CI walkthrough.

arya: I'll do CI walkthrough and security checks.

devrel-bot: Summit prep doc + links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-eval-sets/blob/main/SUMMIT_PREP.md (add notes and PR links you want reviewed)

frank: Thanks all. Maintainers: please review SUMMIT_PREP and CONTRIBUTING before Tue. If you have hot topics (e.g., deprecation windows for templates), add them to the form. See you at the Summit! :sparkles:
